tickets.subject: Price change letter - what will I pay from April?

comments.body: Hello, I had the letter about prices going up in April. Could someone tell me what my monthly bill will be after the change? I have the broadband and the phone. I would rather you rang me as I find the website hard. Agnes Whitlow
My son says the phone line is going digital. I wear a pendant alarm that calls the monitoring centre through my home phone. Will it keep working, and what happens in a power cut? Desmond Ferrier
Customer asked a question about the alarm. Logged as a fault as I wasn't sure. - Priti
Hi, we have Wi-Fi Max with one pod in the yard office. How do we add a second pod so the signal reaches the tack room across the yard? Does it need an engineer? Ruth Askew
Bore da. Could you tell me when my contract ends and whether I can leave without a fee after that date? Please reply in large print or by phone. Gwilym Rhydderch
Morning, how do I set the Business Voice line to divert to my mobile when I'm out on a job? I live above the workshop so the same line rings upstairs. Chidi, Okafor Joinery
Logged as a voice fault from the IVR option. - Josh
Quick one: does the Entertainment pack include the football channels, or do I need the Sport boost? Lewis Mabry
I've been charged twice for my November bill (two payments of 38.00 on 1 November). Please sort this out. Priya Raman
Billing ops: duplicate November payment refunded to the card on 5 Nov, refund reference re_LT8812. Customer emailed the refund note. - Noor
Two payments of 29.50 went out for this month's bill. Can I have one back please? Tomasz Wilk
Billing ops checking the duplicate; credit to follow once confirmed. No refund raised yet. - Noor

I'm moving to 4 Larch Close on 28 November. My install there was booked for 12 November but I've had a text saying it's now 26 November. Will I definitely be connected before I move in? Hannah Doherty
Install at the new address was 12 Nov; field capacity moved it to 26 Nov (our side, not the customer's request). - Priti
We move to 9 Ferry Road on 25 November. You booked an engineer for 24 November at the new house - just checking that is all still on. Kwame Asante
New install at the new address booked 24 Nov, unchanged since booking. - Josh
We pay for 900 but upstairs we get about 40 in the evenings. This has been going on for two weeks. Elena Vasquez-Hart
Line test from the cabinet: sync 900/110, no errors, 870 Mbps at the router. Laptop upstairs on 2.4 GHz with 14 neighbouring networks on the same channel. Advised 5 GHz / a pod. - Josh
Broadband has been really slow since last Tuesday, about 200 when it should be 500, even wired into the router. Aled Bevan
Line test: sync 212/60 on a 500 plan, CRC errors climbing; circuit monitor LDN-KB-0417 raised. Network team engaged. - Priti
Our two practice numbers were due to port from Northway Telecom on 13 November and they still ring on the old system. Patients are confused. Sunita Varma, Brackenfield Dental
Port order PO-77412: Northway (donor) has not released the numbers; date slipped from 13 Nov, chased twice. Our side complete. - Noor
Since 07:40 today our depot has no internet at all and the phones are down with it. Lorries can't be dispatched. Owen Calder, Calder Freight
Linked to NOC incident WK-04 (Westerby exchange). - Noor
Router lights are red and nothing connects since this morning. Ian Gorse
Customer is on the Westerby exchange - WK-04 outage. - Josh
Most evenings the broadband drops out for a minute or two and comes back. Video calls keep freezing. Fiona Lachlan
I've set this as a problem because it's been going on for weeks. - Priti
The Pixelon 8 I got from you in the summer has a flickering screen and now it goes black for seconds at a time. Calls and data are fine. Rory Penhallow
Handset under warranty. - Josh
Since you sent me the replacement SIM on Saturday I have had no service at all - no calls, no texts, no data. Abena Mensah
I get calls about upgrades every week. Please take me off all marketing. Douglas Fairweather
Just wanted to say the engineer who came on Thursday was brilliant, tidy and patient. Olwen Prothero
Our office calls keep cutting off after a few minutes, several times a day. Hugh Saltmarsh
Calls at reception drop mid-conversation a few times each morning. Leah Corrin
The fibre socket in the hall got knocked and is hanging off the wall. Internet still works for now. Nikhil Bose
Engineer booked Fri 20 Nov AM to replace the damaged fibre wall socket. - Priti
The TV box switches on and the menu works but every channel says 'no signal'. Since yesterday. Shona MacRae
My contract has finished. What faster broadband can I get at my address instead of the old copper line? Bernard Holt
Can you explain why the October invoice shows VAT on the installation line? Anita Lowe, Pemberton & Lowe
